npcs.name: Gunnhild the Freewoman
npcs.idle: I wore a collar eleven years. I don't wear anything round my neck now. Not even beads.

npcs.name: Orm the Thrall-Master
npcs.idle: A thrall's a thrall. Gods made them so. Ask me about their prices, not their feelings.

npcs.name: Ragna Farmwife
npcs.idle: We forgot. That's all. One winter we forgot to leave the porridge.

npcs.name: Steading-Reeve Hallgerd
npcs.idle: Every farm from here to the Gotar road pays into the League. The League keeps the wolves off. Lately the League is failing.

npcs.name: Huscarl Brand
npcs.idle: Vasudheim is the King's town. I'd like it to stay that way.

npcs.name: Old Ketilbjorn
npcs.idle: Forty years a shepherd on this moor. Never seen wolves walk with men. Never wanted to.

quests.title: A Thrall's Price
quests.offer:
My brother Ketil is a thrall. I bought my own freedom with eleven years of pennies, and I've been saving for his. I'm nearly there.

And he RAN. Three days ago. Orm the [thrall-master] says there's a bounty. If he's caught, they'll brand him, and my money won't buy him back for any price. Will you [find Ketil] first?

topics.thrall-master: Orm. North of here, at the thrall pens. He'll be pleased to see you. He's pleased to see anyone who might bring him coin.

quests.summary: Gunnhild had nearly saved her brother's thrall-price when he ran away. If he's caught, he'll be branded.

steps.goal: Ask Orm the thrall-master about the runaways
steps.say: Ketil? Ran with three others. They'll be at the old hideout by the strider pools - runaways always go there first. Then south, to join the roaming thralls - bandits, now, every one. If you find him, there's a [bounty] in it.

steps.goal: Search the runaways' hideout by the pools
steps.text: Four collars, cut and dropped. On one, scratched with a knife: 'Sorry, sister.' The trail goes south.

steps.goal: Follow the trail south to the roaming thralls
steps.text: A ragged camp of escaped thralls, armed with stolen axes. They're not friendly.
The bandit leader drops his axe. The others scatter - except one young man, who just sits down in the mud.

stages.name: Ulfar Broken-Collar
stages.announce: A big scarred man with a collar still riveted round his neck strides out. 'Another bounty-hunter. We kill bounty-hunters here.'

steps.say:
Gunnhild sent you. Course she did.

She's been saving eleven years. Eleven years of her life, for me. I couldn't bear it. I thought if I ran, she could spend it on herself for once. I'm not [worth it].

If I go back, Orm brands me as a runaway - but Gunnhild can still buy me, if she pays double. If I run north to the mountains, I'm free, but I can never come down. She'd never see me again.

Tell me to [go back], or to [run north]. I'll do it. I'm tired of choosing badly.

options.say: Back. All right. Branded and bought. At least I'll be bought by my sister.
North, then. Tell her - tell her to buy a farm. Tell her I'll be thinking of her every day. Every day.

steps.say:
He came back. He walked into Orm's yard on his own and held out his arm for the brand.

I paid double. I paid everything. He's free - he's FREE, and he's sitting in my kitchen, and I don't have a penny left. I've never been so rich.

North. Free, and gone.

Eleven years of pennies, and he ran so I'd keep them. The idiot. The dear, stupid idiot. Here. Take some of them. I can't look at them.

quests.title: The Tomte's Due
quests.offer:
The tomte took my baby. Our farm's tomte - the little grey men who've kept the barn since my grandmother's day. We forgot to leave out their porridge at Yule, one winter. Just one!

Since then they've been stealing, breaking things, joining the tomte raiders in the east. And three nights ago, my Ulf, out of his cradle. Please. Will you [bring him back]?
quests.summary: The farm's tomte, angry at being forgotten, stole Ragna's baby from his cradle.

steps.goal: Find the tomte raiders' camp in the east
steps.text: Tents of patched sacking. Tiny fires. Tomte everywhere, grey-bearded and red-capped, and every one of them armed.
Small, quick, and furious. 'Forgotten!' they shout. 'FORGOTTEN!'
Ulf's quilt, folded with care. A tomte scrawl: 'TO THE KING. THE KING DECIDES.' The tomte king holds court on the southern shore.

steps.goal: Go to the tomte king's court on the south shore
steps.text: A little throne of driftwood on the beach. A cradle beside it. And a very loud baby.
The tomte king drops his sceptre - a soup ladle - and sits down hard in the sand.

stages.name: Tomte-King Nisse Grumblebeard
stages.announce: A tomte in a crown of bent nails leaps onto the throne. 'The big folk FORGOT us! Now they will REMEMBER!'

steps.say:
Enough, enough. He's a fool, the king - he's my son. Listen to me, big one.

We kept that farm a hundred years. We were forgotten. Forgotten is worse than hated. We took the babe so somebody would remember us - we'd raise him tomte, and he'd remember.

Take him back. But [promise porridge] - for us, every Yule, forever. Or [no promises], and take him by force. We can't stop you. We'll remember that too.

options.say: Every Yule. With butter. Ha! Go on, then, take the noisy thing. Tell the farmwife the barn will be swept by morning.
No promises. Then go, and take him, and see how your barn does without us.

steps.say:
ULF. Ulf, my Ulf.

Porridge every Yule, with butter? We'll make it with cream. I don't care. And the barn - the barn's swept. I went out this morning and it's swept, and the cow's milked, and there's a little bundle of herbs on the door.

My baby. Oh, thank you, thank you.

The barn burned last night. Nobody hurt. Nobody saw it start. Here - take this. We can rebuild. We have Ulf.

promise.text: Take this - the tomte left it on the step for you.

quests.title: The Shallows
quests.offer:
Rock crabs in the shallows, big as shields. They've taken over the fishing beaches and they pinch the nets to rags.

Will you [clear the shallows]?
quests.summary: Rock crabs have taken over Audliten's fishing shallows.

steps.goal: Clear the rock crabs from the shallows about 360 m south-east of Steading-Reeve Hallgerd

steps.say: The fishers thank you. The League thanks you. The crabs, I expect, do not.

quests.title: The Army Ants
quests.offer:
Army ants march out of the south fields by Dvalin and eat a farm bare in a night. The farmers flood the fields to stop them. It doesn't stop them.

Will you [break the march]?
quests.summary: Army ants march out of the fields by Dvalin and strip the farms.

steps.goal: Break the army ants' march about 710 m south-east of Steading-Reeve Hallgerd

steps.say: Broken - but there's a mound in the south with soldiers guarding it. Break that and they're done for a year.

quests.title: The Mound
quests.offer:
The ant mound south of Dvalin - a hill of it, crawling. The soldiers guard it. Kill the soldiers and the workers scatter.

Will you [take the mound]?
quests.summary: An army ant mound south of Dvalin is guarded by soldier ants.

steps.goal: Kill the army ant soldiers at the mound about 800 m south-east of Steading-Reeve Hallgerd

steps.say: Done. The League owes you. And there's harder work coming - talk to Old Ketilbjorn on the moor. He's seen something.

quests.title: The Dirges
quests.offer:
The dirges walk the old roads in the north - ghosts that sing, and anyone who listens too long lies down and doesn't get up. More of them every week.

Will you [quiet them]?
quests.summary: The nordic dirges, singing ghosts, walk East Svealand's old northern roads in growing numbers.

steps.goal: Quiet the nordic dirges about 840 m west of Huscarl Brand

steps.say: Quiet. What were they singing? The farmers say it's always the same song now - a winter song.

quests.title: Wayward
quests.offer:
Wayward ghouls on the far northern road, digging. Into the old dwarf barrow. Ghouls don't dig - they eat what's left out.

Will you [stop them]?
quests.summary: Wayward ghouls are digging at the old dwarf barrow on East Svealand's northern road.

steps.goal: Stop the wayward ghouls about 820 m west of Huscarl Brand

steps.say: They were digging toward the barrow. Something in there is calling them. Or something out here wants in.

quests.title: The Sealed Barrow
quests.offer:
The dwarf barrow on the northern road is open, and the dwarves inside are up and walking. Bone and old iron.

It's a job for a few. Will you [go into the barrow]? Find out why they sealed it.
quests.summary: The old dwarf barrow on East Svealand's northern road is open, and its dead are walking.

steps.goal: Put down the dwarf bone skeletons about 680 m west of Huscarl Brand

steps.text: Dwarf runes: 'THE COLD CAME OUT OF THE WEST IN THE YEAR OF THE GREY WOLF. WE SEALED OURSELVES IN. DO NOT OPEN UNTIL SPRING.' Somebody opened it. It is not spring in the west.

steps.say: 'The year of the grey wolf.' They sealed themselves in against a winter. Last time it came. Gods help us.

quests.title: The Tomte Raiders
quests.offer:
The tomte used to keep a farm - sweep the barn, mind the beasts, for a bowl of porridge. These ones don't. These ones raid. They come down from the south hills in gangs.

Will you [drive them off]?
quests.summary: Gangs of tomte pillagers raid East Svealand's farms from the southern hills.

steps.goal: Drive off the tomte pillagers about 800 m south-east of Ragna Farmwife

steps.say: Off - for now. They were frightened, my husband says. Running from something and robbing as they ran.

quests.title: The Aggressors
quests.offer:
The worst of the tomte - aggressors, the farmers call them - have made a camp in the eastern hills. They're the ones who lead the raids.

Will you [break them]?
quests.summary: Tomte aggressors lead the raids on East Svealand's farms from a camp in the eastern hills.

steps.goal: Break the tomte aggressors about 910 m south-east of Ragna Farmwife

steps.say: One of them was carrying a silver scale. Not a fish's. Something bigger, from the south, by Nisse's Lair.

quests.title: Bold Wolves
quests.offer:
The sveawolf mothers bring their packs right up to the folds now. In daylight. A wolf doesn't come near men in daylight unless it isn't afraid of them any more.

Will you [teach them fear]?
quests.summary: Sveawolf packs come up to East Svealand's sheepfolds in daylight.

steps.goal: Teach the sveawolf mothers fear about 160 m south of Old Ketilbjorn

steps.say: They'll learn. Or they won't. Either way, I've stopped sleeping.

quests.title: The Lupines
quests.offer:
Lupines - the big ones, half wolf, half something worse - came over the eastern hills a month ago. They walk on two legs when they think no one's watching.

Will you [hunt them]?
quests.summary: Lupines, half wolf and half something worse, came over East Svealand's eastern hills.

steps.goal: Hunt the lupine snarlers about 440 m east of Old Ketilbjorn

steps.say: Two legs. I told you. And there are men out there with them - men in wolf-skins, with the heads still on.

quests.title: Men in Wolf-Skins
quests.offer:
Ketilbjorn's men in wolf-skins - the Grey Hames, they call themselves. Wildlings. They swear blood-oaths to the Fenris-wolf's children and run with the packs. Their scouts watch every road.

Will you [blind their scouts]?
quests.summary: The Grey Hames, wildlings in wolf-hames sworn to Fenrir's children, watch East Svealand's roads.

steps.goal: Kill the Grey Hame scouts about 1.0 km east of Steading-Reeve Hallgerd

steps.say: Blind - for now. And they've taken a steading. Ulfrstead, by the tomte hills. The family got out. Most of them.

quests.title: Ulfrstead
quests.offer:
Go to Ulfrstead. Not to fight - to look. Count them. See what they've done to the place. The League won't send its men in blind.

Will you [scout Ulfrstead]?
quests.summary: The Grey Hames and their wolves have taken Ulfrstead, a steading by the tomte hills.

steps.text: Smoke from the hall, wolves in the yard, and men in wolf-hames on the walls. Too many to count.

clue.name: a wolf-hame nailed over the gate

steps.text: A wolf's whole skin nailed up like a banner, and burnt into the gate-post: 'FENRIR'S CHILDREN WALK. THE WINTER WALKS WITH THEM.'

steps.say:
'The winter walks with them.' Then the League takes Ulfrstead back before winter does.

We need the farms behind us. Every wolf killed, every raid stopped - it all tells the League's men they can win. When they're ready, they'll march. Be there.

quests.title: Drakelings
quests.offer:
Drakelings at the mouth of Nisse's Lair, in the south. There were always a few. Now there are dozens, and they're not wild - they come when somebody whistles.

Will you [thin them]?
quests.summary: Drakelings swarm at the mouth of Nisse's Lair in East Svealand's south - and come when someone whistles.

steps.goal: Thin out the envy drakelings about 840 m south-west of Huscarl Brand

steps.say: Somebody whistles for them. Somebody is feeding them. Find out who.

quests.title: The Silverscales
quests.offer:
The silverscale drakelings - the big ones - guard a nest by Nisse's Lair. The tomte had a scale from it. So the nest is real.

Will you [find the nest]?
quests.summary: Silverscale drakelings guard a nest by Nisse's Lair.

steps.goal: Kill the silverscale drakelings about 770 m south-west of Huscarl Brand

clue.name: a nest of warm stones and a feeding-trough

steps.text: A trough - a man-made trough - full of meat, and a cloak-pin shaped like a dragon's eye. Somebody keeps this nest.

steps.say: A dragon's eye. Thorvald up at Fort Veldon sent word of a preacher with the same mark, in the Vendo Caverns. They're spreading.

quests.title: The Brood-Keeper
quests.offer:
The nest's keeper comes at dusk to feed them - a drakulv missionary, the farmers say, in a red-scaled cloak, on his way north from Gotar. He'll have his brood round him.

Bring friends. Will you [wait for him at dusk]?
quests.summary: A drakulv missionary keeps the drakeling nest by Nisse's Lair on his way north from Gotar.

steps.goal: Defeat Ottar Wyrm-Tongue at the nest
steps.text: The missionary falls into his own trough. His whistle rolls out of his hand.

stages.name: Ottar Wyrm-Tongue
stages.announce: A man in a red-scaled cloak whistles, and the drakelings come running: 'Little ones. Supper's here.'

steps.say:
He had a pass on him - svartalf work, from the trading-post in Gotar. The svartalf carry them north and the drakulv ride along.

Gotar, then. That's where this road starts.
